question:
A fine sand has a grain size distribution as listed in Table @tab-psd. The porosity of the sand is $\phi=0.37$

Calculate the estimated intrinsic permeability $k$ in $10^{-12} \text{ m}^2$ to two decimal places using the Kozeny-Carman correlation

The same sample is compacted so the porosity decreases by 25%. What is the new intrinsic permeability according to the Kozeny-Carman equation? Again in two decimal places and in $10^{-12} \text{ m}^2$

A different permeability model is the Hazen equation: $k= C \cdot d_{10}^2 $. Use literature to find an appropriate value for C and calculate the intrinsic permeability. Do so in one decimal place and in $10^{-12} \text{ m}^2$
